pane.title: how keys work
pane.content:
Two modes — the bottom bar shows which.

NAV (default)
  arrows       move focus to the pane that way
  Tab / S-Tab  cycle focus
  Enter        LOCK focus into this pane
  F1           this help, as a popup
  F3           theme & style settings
  Ctrl+C       quit — raises a [Y/n] confirm

LOCKED
  every key goes to the pane's widget
  Esc          release the lock
  Esc Esc      literal Esc to a shell child
  Ctrl+C       kill THIS pane's process (confirm)

The engine ACTIONS a binding can name:
  quit  focus-next  focus-prev  help  settings  lock  unlock

This config also bound:
  alt+n -> focus-next
  alt+p -> focus-prev
  alt+h -> help

Lock this pane (Enter) and scroll:
  j / k    line    pgdn / pgup  page
  g        top     Esc          release

The rounded border colour marks focus;
it turns amber while LOCKED.

pane.title: pane 3
pane.content:
Focus cycles through panes in the order they appear in the layout tree:

  1  how keys work
  2  long text
  3  this pane
  4  live keys

Arrows pick the nearest pane in that direction; Tab just walks the ring and wraps at the ends.
